description: Tear down an ephemeral branch config and every value it overrode. The parent environment is untouched — only the branch's own overrides go — which makes this the routine cleanup when a PR merges. Irreversible; creating a branch mints a data key, so create_branch stays on the local crypto plane. Find the slug with list_branches. Returns { ok, branch }.

app.description: Application slug or id, as returned by list_apps (e.g. "storefront").

branch.description: Branch slug or id within the application, as returned by list_branches.

org.description: Organization slug or id. Omit it when the credential can reach exactly one org — that org is used automatically. With several, the error names every slug you may pass; list them yourself with list_orgs.

name: delete_branch
